title: Grandmother and Girls in Communion Dress, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Centerline Conway, Aggie Grandm. & Ault Pat & Gert
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from around the late 1920s depicting an elderly grandmother standing outside a brick home alongside three young girls. One child on the left wears a white veil and dress reminiscent of First Communion attire. The back features handwritten family notations including 'Centerline', 'Conway', 'Aggie Grandm.', 'Pat & Gert'.
